risk_description: In some cases the end mount of the seat belt on the driver’s seat may not have been fitted in accordance with the specifications, for this case the end mount of the seat belt would be held in position only by the external seat trim. In the event of adverse conditions or an accident this could seriously impair the restraining function of the seat belt and increase the risk of injury to the driver.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the requirements laid down in the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of Motor Vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
